description: Add splices (auto-tagged SP1, SP2…): one-conductor joints like a terminal strip, created on demand. Every wire lands on SP1:1 and a splice takes any number of wires. Usually fix_fanouts via "splice" creates them for you. part = a Codex splice part (id or part number, category splice) whose wire range and most wires validate_project checks; omit for a generic splice. Remove one with remove_components.

part.description: Splice part id or part number (category splice). Omit for a generic splice.
